content.Text:
File saved at `apps/interface/src/features/CreationLaunchpad/components/ProjectMenu.tsx`.

**What it provides:**

- **Project cards** with title, type icon, status indicator, and created date
- **Status dots:** queued (yellow), building (blue spinning), complete (green check), error (red X)
- **Edit** dispatches `nia.launchpad.edit` (re-open in Notes or spawn refinement session)
- **Launch** dispatches type-specific events: `open.godot` (game), `open.browser` (app), `activate.feature` (feature)
- **Delete** with confirm dialog, calls `DELETE /api/launchpad/projects/:id`
- **Data fetching** from `GET /api/launchpad/projects`, auto-refreshes on `nia.pipeline.status` events
- **Mobile-first** single-column layout, 2-column on `sm+`
- **Styling** matches existing Launchpad theme (same colors, borders, fonts)

The API stub route (`/api/launchpad/projects`) will need to be created when the backend is wired up.
